component.summary: Current conditions and forecasts for chosen cities
चुने गए शहरों का वर्तमान मौसम और पूर्वानुमान

description.p: Weather shows current conditions, an hourly forecast and ten days ahead for the cities you choose.
It never looks up your location. Forecasts come from Open-Meteo and the last one stays available offline.
